test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If A, B and C can complete a task alone in 15 days, 20 days and 25 days, respectively, then in how many days can they complete the same task if they work together?
solution:
**Given:**

 A, B and C can complete a task alone in 15 days, 20 days and 25 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

LCM of 15, 20, 25 = 300 i.e total work,

Efficiency of A = 300/15 = 20

Efficiency of B = 300/20 = 15

Efficiency of C = 300/25 = 12

Effective efficiency = 20 + 15 + 12 = 47

Now,

If they work together they will take 300/47 days

**∴ Required time is (300)/(47) days**
